column3: (Storable and Cacheable Content: only public static files; hashed build assets are cached for a year on purpose, index.html is no-cache)
(Modern Web Application: informational, it only tells ZAP the site is a single-page app)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: the app does not need cross-origin isolation; COOP and CORP are set, and COEP require-corp can break the browser PDF viewer)
